messages.subject: Condition `lambda < 1.0 / lambda_lim' is not TRUE
parts:
Hi, 

I am a new R-INLA user and I am trying to fit a competing risks model. I started with a very simple model with no covariates. I got the error "condition `lambda < 1.0 / lambda_lim' is not TRUE" but I am not sure where is wrong.

Here is part of my code:
N <- length(gc_data2$failtime)
gc.o <- inla.surv(time = c(rep(NA,N),gc_data2$failtime),
                     event = c(rep(NA,N),gc_data2$censor1))

gc.d <- inla.surv(time = c(gc_data2$failtime,rep(NA,N)),
                    event = c(gc_data2$censor2,rep(NA,N)))
gc.o.d<-list(gc.o,gc.d)

formula.model= gc.o.d ~ 1

Jointmodel= inla(formula.model, family = c("weibull.surv","weibull.surv"),
                 data = gc_data2, verbose=TRUE)

In verbose = TRUE I got those messages below:

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Condition `lambda < 1.0 / lambda_lim' is not TRUE
parts:
you probably have to scale the data, as the exponential in the weibull
is a little tricky,

like

time = time /max(time)

or median
